rustySword.description: A well-worn sword with patches of rust along the blade. Looks barely functional.
rustySword.effect: Low damage weapon, better than nothing.

healingPotion.description: A small vial filled with a glowing, red liquid.
healingPotion.effect: Restores a moderate amount of health (30 HP) instantly.

sturdyRope.description: A thick coil of hemp rope, strong enough to hold the weight of a heavy warrior.
sturdyRope.effect: Allows climbing up the steep cliffs in **rockyHills** to reach the treasure.

compass.description: A tarnished brass compass. The needle spins wildly until it settles North.
compass.effect: Prevents getting lost in the **enchantedForest** or **mistyLake**.

lantern.description: A rusty but functional oil lamp. The flame burns with a steady, warm glow.
lantern.effect: Essential for seeing inside the **obsidianTower** and **rockyHills caves** without penalty.

boneKey.description: An ominous key carved from a single piece of human bone.
boneKey.effect: Unlocks the heavy gates of the **obsidianTower**.

manaCrystal.description: A raw chunk of crystallized magic pulsating with blue light.
manaCrystal.effect: Can be used to amplify spells or sold for a high price.

diamond.description: A flawless, sparkling gem found deep underground.
diamond.effect: Extremely valuable. Can be traded for almost anything.

apple.description: A shiny red apple. Looks delicious.
apple.effect: Restores a small amount of health (5 HP).

rawFish.description: A slippery, cold fish caught from the lake.
rawFish.effect: Can be cooked for food, or used to distract beasts.

glowingMushroom.description: A fungus that emits a soft, ethereal light.
glowingMushroom.effect: Provides weak temporary light. Eating it causes hallucinations.

darkCrystal.description: A jagged shard of black, cold crystal that seems to absorb light.
darkCrystal.effect: A powerful component for dark magic or a valuable treasure.

ancientScroll.description: A brittle, yellowed parchment tied with a ribbon. The writing is in an unknown language.
ancientScroll.effect: Contains a powerful spell or forgotten knowledge.
